```{r}
#density at 5
dunif(5,min=0,max=10)
punif(5,min=0,max=10)
qunif(0.95,min=0,max = 10)
random_numbers=runif(10,min = 0,max = 10)
random_numbers



library(ggplot2)

x<-seq(0,10,length.out=1000)
pdf<-dunif(x,min=0,max = 10)

unfirom_data<-data.frame(
  x=x,
  pdf=pdf
)

ggplot(unfirom_data,aes(x,pdf))+
  geom_line(colour = 'blue',linewidth = 2)+
  labs(
    x="x values",
    y="pdf",
    title = "Main pdf of uniform ditribution"
  )+
  theme_minimal()

```
```{r}

cdf<-punif(x,min = 0,max = 10)
uniform_cdf<-data.frame(
  x=x,
  cdf=cdf
)
ggplot(uniform_cdf,aes(x,cdf))+
  geom_line(colour = 'blue',linewidth = 2)+
  labs(
    x="x values",
    y="cdf",
    title = "Main pdf of uniform ditribution"
  )+
  theme_minimal()



```

```{r}
dnorm(60,mean = 50,sd=10)
pnorm(60,mean=50,sd=10)
pnorm(60,mean=50,sd=10)
qnorm(0.95,mean = 50,sd=10)
rnorm(10,mean=50,sd=10)
x<-60
curve(dnorm(x,mean=50,sd=10),
      from = 10,to=90)
library(ggplot2)
x_values<-seq(10,90,length.out=1000)
pdf_norm<-dnorm(x_values,mean = 50,sd=10)
my_data<-data.frame(
  x=x_values,
  pdf_norm=pdf_norm
)
ggplot(my_data,aes(x,pdf_norm))+
  geom_line(color='blue',linewidth=1.2)+
  labs(
    x="x-axis values",
    y="normal curve things"
  )

```
```{r}

dnorm(1.96)
pnorm(1.96)
pnorm(1.96,lower.tail = FALSE)
qnorm(0.976)
rnorm(10)

std_norm<-seq(-4,4,length.out=1000)
pdf_std_norm<-dnorm(std_norm)
std_data<-data.frame(
  x=std_norm,
  pdf=pdf_std_norm
)
ggplot(std_data,aes(x,pdf))+
  geom_line(color='green',linewidth = 1.2)+
  labs(
    x="X axis",
    y="y axis ",
    title = "Main standered normal distribution"
  )

```

```{r}
std_norm<-seq(-4,4,length.out=1000)
cdf_std_norm<-pnorm(std_norm)
std_data<-data.frame(
  x=std_norm,
  cdf=cdf_std_norm
)
ggplot(std_data,aes(x,cdf))+
  geom_line(color='green',linewidth = 1.2)+
  labs(
    x="X axis",
    y="y axis ",
    title = "Main standered normal distribution"
  )

```

```{r}
##Checking normality
```

```{r}
datasets::mtcars

disp_col<-mtcars$disp
hist(disp_col)

```
```{r}
qqnorm(disp_col,main = "Normal Q-Q Plot")
qqline(disp_col, col = "red", lwd = 2)
```
```{r}
shapiro.test(disp_col)

```
```{r}
library(nortest)

ad.test(disp_col)
```
